fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. Jesus says many “…will come from the east and the west to share the banquet with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the kingdom of heaven.” So the guests come from far and wide, and what they share is the banquet. A banquet is right up my alley, friend, and mine would have cookies on every plate.

The text says the opposite, friend. “And his servant was healed at that very hour.” That's what the text records, right after Jesus says, “Go! As you have believed, so will it be done for you.” So this one is True.
